title: UCLA discovers first stroke rehabilitation drug to repair brain damage (2025)
summary: UCLA researchers have discovered the first stroke rehabilitation drug capable of repairing brain damage, representing a major breakthrough in stroke treatment and neural regeneration medicine.
problem_solved: Provides the first pharmacological treatment option to repair brain damage in stroke survivors, who previously had no drug-based rehabilitation options.
why_valuable: This groundbreaking discovery offers hope to millions of stroke patients worldwide by potentially restoring brain function that was previously considered permanent damage.
